data.subject: The Whip's Weekly Preview: Friday, November 13, 2026
data.weekAheadText:
Monday, November 16, 2026
On Monday, the House is not in session.

Tuesday, November 17, 2026
On Tuesday, the House will meet at 12:00 p.m. for Morning Hour debate and 2:00 p.m. for legislative business, with votes postponed until 6:30 p.m.

Suspensions (10 bills)

  1. H.R. 7954 – Don Young Doug LaMalfa Indian Buffalo Management Act (Rep. Hurd – Natural Resources)
  2. H.R. 8195 – Responsible Cormorant Management and Control Act of 2026, as amended (Rep. Walberg – Natural Resources)
  3. H.R. 8483 – Barona Group of Capitan Grande Band of Mission Indians Land Transfer Act of 2026, as amended (Rep. Issa – Natural Resources)
  4. H.R. 9600 – Common Sense 250 Act of 2026 (Rep. Raskin – Natural Resources)
  5. H.R. 10136 – Crossett Experimental Forest Act of 2026, as amended (Rep. Westerman – Natural Resources)
  6. H.R. 9640 – Earth MRI Reauthorization Act of 2026, as amended (Rep. Wittman – Natural Resources)
  7. H.R. 9785 – South Dakota Water Feasibility Studies Act, as amended (Rep. Johnson (SD) – Natural Resources)
  8. H.R. 9269 – Renewing the African American Civil Rights Network Act, as amended (Rep. Clyburn – Natural Resources)
  9. Senate Amendment to H.R. 2400 – Pit River Land Transfer Act of 2026, as amended (Rep. LaMalfa – Natural Resources)
  10. H.R. 7254 – To amend the National Trails System Act to direct the Secretary of the Interior to conduct a study on the feasibility of designating the Bay Area Ridge National Scenic Trail, as amended (Rep. Huffman – Natural Resources)

Wednesday, November 18, 2026 and the Balance of the Week
On Wednesday and Thursday, the House will meet at 10:00 a.m. for Morning Hour and 12:00 p.m. for legislative business. On Friday, the House will meet at 9:00 a.m. for legislative business, with last votes expected no later than 3:00 p.m.

Suspensions (3 bills)

  1. H.R. 5490 – Dismantle Foreign Scam Syndicates Act, as amended (Rep. Shreve – Foreign Affairs)
  2. H.R. 4464 – Preventive Health Savings Act (Rep. Obernolte – Budget)
  3. H.R. 7934 – Settlement Agreement Information Database Act of 2026 (Rep. Palmer – Oversight and Government Reform)

H.R. 5267 – American Franchise Act (Rep. Hern – Education and Workforce) (Subject to a Rule)

H.R. 3495 – Direct Seller and Real Estate Agent Harmonization Act (Rep. Kiley – Education and Workforce) (Subject to a Rule)

Additional Legislative Items are Possible
